recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. The current core source correctly reflects FHIR-13092 as modified by later published decisions; no follow-up is needed unless the work group changes completed QuestionnaireResponse handling for display, unanswered, or disabled items.
issue_request: FHIR-13092 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2. It asked whether QuestionnaireResponse.item.linkId should be mandatory only when type is not display; the approved resolution said display items may be omitted, but included display items should still point back with linkId, and guidance should cover relevant display items and not-enabled items.
initial_application: SVN-mirrored commit e3b09d6fbb06b0791fb8d6c891df650930f62201, noted in the Jira comment as revision 13076, added the QuestionnaireResponse Links to Questionnaire notes for #13092. The change added display-item and not-enabled-item guidance and did not relax QuestionnaireResponse.item.linkId cardinality.
additional_context: Later published decisions refined the same text. FHIR-25949 clarified that ordinary unanswered question items are removed while display items may be retained when needed. FHIR-31077 replaced the older not-enabled wording with the current status-sensitive rule for incomplete versus completed/amended QuestionnaireResponses. FHIR-37550 later clarified non-resolving/extension-only questionnaire context and linkId interpretation without changing this display-item decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini keeps QuestionnaireResponse active, source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml keeps item.linkId at 1..1, and source/questionnaireresponse/questionnaireresponse-notes.xml already includes the current relevant display-item and not-enabled item guidance.
